title: Revengeance is Mine, Part Cat
description: Revengeance is Mine, Part Cat — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Quest Type: Hunt/Collect

Quest Description: Find the Dig Site in Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace. Once there, kill [GG] Your Little Sister and recover the scroll from his corpse. Bring the scroll to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Sir Ving N'Seacressy

Repeatable: No

Zone: The Shadow's Embrace (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Find the Dig Site in Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace. Once there, kill [GG] Your Little Sister and recover the scroll from his corpse. Bring the scroll to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Gate.

Offer:

I was on a mission for K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S.--that's right, I'm an agent of K.I.C.K.A.S.S.S. I'm dead now, so who cares who knows? Shut up and let me finish.

Anyway, the Guild of Shadows was looting an archaeological dig site in Level 4 of the Shadow's Embrace. I spied the Ancient Scroll of Ecto Neutrality in the rubble and couldn't let them have it. I grabbed the scroll and ran. They fought me all the way back here, where I died. The one they called [GG] Your Little Sister grabbed the scroll before going back to the dig site. You know what? I don't think he even killed me for the scroll. He just did it so *I* couldn't have it. What a jerk!

If you're up for it--and by the looks of you I'm not sure that you are--I need you to go back to the dig site and recover that scroll. Bring it back to Sir Ving N'Seacressy in the Shadow's Embrace and tell him, When Whiskers wish to whistle, women want to weep. He'll know what to do.

Where is the site? Great Gosh and a pickled pie...I already told you. It's on Level 4. It's a big hole in the ground. You can't miss it. Or maybe *you* can. I'm starting to worry that I am passing the torch to the wrong person.

Turn-in:

You say you recovered this scroll for the late Sir Vaiveir, When Whiskers wish to whistle, women want to weep? Certainly, that phrase means nothing to me. However, I *will* take that scroll for whenever the rightful owner appears.

By the way, this is just a laundry list.

Objectives:

  • Kill [GG] Your Little Sister
  • Ragged Scroll ×1

Level range: 47–100
